exact.Questa azienda usa Greenhouse. Di norma: This company uses Greenhouse. It normally does not score CVs automatically: recruiters read applications and search by keyword. What matters is that the ad's words are in the CV and that any application questions get complete answers.
exact.Questa azienda usa Lever. Il CV viene le: This company uses Lever. The CV is parsed and made searchable, with no automatic score: recruiters filter by keywords and tags. A PDF with selectable text and standard section headings is parsed better.
exact.Questa azienda usa Ashby. Può affiancare: This company uses Ashby. It can give the recruiter an AI-assisted assessment against the ad's criteria (if the company enables it): requirements must be stated explicitly in the CV, not implied.
exact.Questa azienda usa Workable, che può mos: This company uses Workable, which can show the recruiter a match index between CV and ad. Ad keywords present in the CV weigh heavily.
exact.Questa azienda usa SmartRecruiters, che: This company uses SmartRecruiters, which has a match-scoring feature (SmartAssistant) based on skills, experience and education. Role titles and skills written as in the ad help.
exact.Questa azienda usa Personio: gestione de: This company uses Personio: application tracking with no automatic score. The recruiter decides by reading the CV.
exact.Questa azienda usa Recruitee: candidatur: This company uses Recruitee: applications handled manually by the team, with keyword search.
exact.Candidatura da LinkedIn: il selezionator: Application via LinkedIn: the recruiter sees a match summary based on the skills and titles of the LinkedIn profile, as well as the CV. It pays to align the profile's skills with the ad's.
exact.Sistema di selezione dell'azienda non no: The company's recruiting system is not known. The general rule applies: CV as PDF with selectable text, sections with standard headings, the ad's words used where true.
